task: Flip the switch on the wall.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied in setups without a siren. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch.” Make the toggle requirement conditional on a switch being present; do not require it when the switch is absent.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) matches “Flip the switch,” but the event cannot occur when the setup has no switch. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch.” This makes the required flip impossible in those setups.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied in setups without a switch. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch and siren_ringing is never true.” Exclude setups without a siren or change the task/environment so the switch is available.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied in setups without a siren. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch.” Ensure the setup includes a switch, or the task cannot be fulfilled in those setups.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied in a setup without a siren. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch and `siren_ringing` is never true.” Restrict this task to setups with a switch, or revise the task for setups where the switch is absent.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied in a setup without a siren: the environment says, “A missing siren has no switch.” Make the task conditional on a switch being present or exclude setups without one.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) matches “Flip the switch on the wall,” but it cannot be satisfied in a setup without a siren: the environment says, “A missing siren has no switch.” Ensure this task’s setup includes the siren and switch; otherwise the required event is impossible.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied in setups without a siren. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch.” The task requires flipping the switch, so it is impossible in those setups; the candidate cannot satisfy the task across the described environment.
